name: Extra Improved Wild Shape
body:
You unlocked a new shapechanging ability.

Prerequisite(s): Improved wild shape class feature.

Benefit(s): Select an additional spell from the improved wild shape list. Your improved wild shape ability can now have that effect as well. You can only select an effect you would normally have access to based on your shapemaster level.
